title: Nonlinear Coupling of Buoyancy Reversal and Radiation
exact_target: Determine whether evaporative buoyancy reversal couples nonlinearly to radiative and other cloud-top forcings.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001532 (OWR-4415-005). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Theory and Modelling in Atmosphere-Ocean-Science (2010), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2010/34, pp. 2027--2099; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 36--37, printed pages 2062--2063.

status_qualification: The source concerns cloud-top entrainment and specifically lists additional unresolved roles of shear, evaporation rates, droplet settling, and clustering. The extracted coupling question has no single specified PDE or coupling coefficient, so none is invented.
